_about: Each entry records the provenance fields the Verifier needs to check a claim:
Values are taken ONLY from the source documents and the sources/manifest.json.
Fields that were not verified are recorded as 'not verified' / 'not checked' / null —
never fabricated. effective=null means in-force status was not checked.
The generated chunk-level records (with SHA-256, chunk counts, etc.) are in
The curated source-level provenance is in knowledge_base/sources/manifest.json.

notes.effective_status: Not verified for any source. Commencement of individual provisions is notified separately and was not checked. The Verifier therefore cannot return VERIFIED for any claim — the maximum achievable outcome is INCOMPLETE.
notes.amendment_status: Not checked for any source. A later CERT-In notice (27 June 2022) exists and was not ingested. The TRAI Act consolidation date is unknown.
notes.in_force_policy: effective=null is set on every chunk in the vector store. The Verifier treats null as unchecked and blocks VERIFIED.
notes.fabrication_policy: No metadata value may be invented. Missing values must use the explicit strings below.
